annotations.title: Verses for a need or feeling

description: Return the short, hand-picked set of verses The Living Bread pairs with one of 99 needs or feelings (anxiety, fear, grief, loneliness, anger, guilt, doubt, money, marriage, healing and more), matched from the person's own words: need is scanned for a need name, then a synonym ("scared" finds fear, "my mother died" finds grief), so a whole sentence works. Use for "a verse for anxiety" or "scripture for my friend who lost her dad". Not for a topic explained verse by verse (what_the_bible_says_about), a written prayer (a_prayer_for), a known reference (scripture_passage), or literal wording (scripture_search). Verses are read verbatim from the stored KJV, or from the stored Bible chosen by translation or language (ids from list_translations); each one-line why is the house's words, not Scripture. No match returns an error listing the needs held; an unknown translation or language returns an error pointing to list_translations. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language of the person, e.g. "es", "pt-BR", "sw", "zh-Hant". Picks the best stored public domain or freely licensed translation for that language; translation overrides it.

need.description: The need or feeling in the person's own words: "I'm scared about surgery", "my mother died", "lonely", "anxiety".

translation.description: Optional translation id from list_translations, e.g. "bsb", "web", "dra", "rv1909", "lsg", "cuv", "neno", "wlc", "byz". Default: the King James Version (or the language default).

name: verses_for

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

label.description: Display name of the matched need.

lead.description: One sentence introducing the set, in the house's words.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

matched.description: The word from the input that produced the match.

need.description: Slug of the matched need, e.g. "anxiety".

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

page.description: Web page for this need, where believers pray over it.

pray_with_the_family.description: Link where the person can ask the family to pray for them.

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

translation.description: Translation code the verses were read from: KJV by default.

verses.description: Verses in the house's order: reference, verbatim KJV text, and an optional one-line why (house words).

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Verses for a need or feeling
